description: This file defines the EventParsingIterator class, which implements an iterator to decode, validate, and process binary encoded event streams in AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: EventParsingIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for parsing and decoding AWS event streams, handling different stream seekability and event types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a stream, shape, and parser, choosing the appropriate decoding iterator based on stream seekability.

methods.name: chooseDecodingIterator
methods.description: Selects and returns a decoding iterator implementation depending on whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current parsed event from the decoding iterator.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element in the decoding iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the decoding iterator to the next element.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the decoding iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the decoding iterator is valid.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses an individual event, handling error and initial response types, and extracting headers and payloads based on shape.

methods.name: parseEventHeaders
methods.description: Extracts header information from the event based on the shape's members.

methods.name: parseEventPayload
methods.description: Deserializes the event payload according to the shape's member definitions.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Throws an exception for error events with specific error code and message.

methods.name: parseInitialResponseEvent
methods.description: Decodes the initial response event payload into an array.
